title: Existing salon adds 20 kW rooftop solar + battery (grid-tied) — Guaynabo, zone X
description: Our beauty salon in Guaynabo wants to install a 20 kW rooftop solar system with a battery on the building we own. It will stay connected to the LUMA grid.

parallel_operation.evidence: stay connected to the LUMA grid

mustInclude.rationale: energy.test.ts B / E07: grid-parallel rooftop DG -> LUMA interconnection (Reg. 8915).
energy.test.ts B: commercial DG <=1 MW -> net metering (Ley 114-2007).
Battery storage -> Bomberos BESS fire review (NFPA 855 in the process graph).

mustNotInclude.rationale: No microgrid wording: projectContext drops microgrid claims (MICROGRID_STATED_RE); energy.test.ts 'not assumed to be a microgrid'.
No energy sale / services: energy.test.ts 'no energy-company certification assumed'.
Behind-the-meter, no sale to LUMA: utility PPOA path cannot apply.
supersededLegacyCards: when PR_ENERGY_DG_INTERCONNECTION renders, the legacy LUMA card must be suppressed (no duplicate card).
supersededLegacyCards: when PR_ENERGY_NET_METERING renders, the legacy net-metering card must be suppressed.
Pin in FEMA zone X: RULE_0706/0707 need location.flood_zone.sfha / floodway, which zone X never sets.
Pin outside the official coastal zone (NOAA CZMA answered 'outside'): RULE_0708 needs location.czm. A coastal-flagged municipio alone must not trigger it.
No SREP land and no change of use in a residential/conservation/agricultural district: RULE_0709-0712 cannot fire.
Existing business: normalizeEntityFormationRequirements never adds formation steps for existing_business / project_only, and entityNotFormed is false.

A 20 kW rooftop PV + battery on an existing building is an equipment install; a REQUIRED OGPe construction permit would be a false positive (may-apply is acceptable pending an expert view of OGPe solar exemptions).

ordering.rationale: energy.test.ts: net metering has a blocking prerequisite on DG interconnection.
